**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The assignment provision at ¶(h) already delivers our preferred outcome on the points that matter most:

- **AP's assignment freedom is protected** — consent-free assignment to an affiliate, to a purchaser of all or substantially all relevant assets, or to a successor by merger, stock sale or consolidation.
- **Consent standard is qualified** — "shall not be unreasonably withheld" for any other assignment, applying to both parties.
- **No change-of-control exit for Kubient** — the phrase appears nowhere in the document, and the termination provisions (¶p0016) are limited to mutual insolvency/breach triggers, so there is no walk-away risk of a Vendor termination or re-pricing right on an AP change of control.

The single gap versus the preferred position is the lack of an express prohibition on Kubient assigning to an AP competitor. Because the clause is otherwise fully symmetric and already meets the fallback (mutual successor assignment plus a reasonableness consent standard), I did not propose an edit — making the carve-out one-sided would be disproportionate to the residual risk. Worth noting for awareness only: the Kubient License at ¶2 is described as "non-transferable, non-assignable," but that restricts transfer/sublicensing of the license grant, not assignment of the Agreement, which ¶(h) governs.
